items.title: Header tail
items.description: Component header-tail: the right end of the header row (the tab row): the window buttons minimize, maximize and close, after the drag area. Used by every frame with a tab row and the launch screen. Matches src/workspace/header.rs.

items.title: Rail: open folder
items.description: Component rail-open: the Open folder button at the bottom of the activity rail, above Settings. Opens the folder picker (Ctrl+O). Used by every frame that shows the rail. Matches src/workspace/chrome.rs.
